summary: Possible typosquat of @solana/web3.js with suspicious code patterns
details: Package name @solana-labs/web3js closely resembles the legitimate @solana/web3.js library (scope swap from @solana to @solana-labs and removal of the dot). The bundled lib/index.cjs.js and lib/index.esm.js contain co-occurrences of require('child_process'), curl/ping invocations, hardcoded POST/fetch calls, and other patterns commonly associated with credential exfiltration or command execution shapes — including child_process usage near curl/ping in lib/index.esm.js around lines 11336-11541, and POST/fetch calls in lib/index.cjs.js around lines 5046 and 11458. These keyword co-occurrences in a minified bundle are not by themselves proof of malicious intent, but the combination of (a) a scope/name that confuses with a top-tier Solana SDK and (b) child_process + curl + hardcoded POST endpoints inside a library that has no legitimate need for shell or external network beacons warrants human review before installer trust is granted. The destinations and exact data flow could not be fully traced.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
